Subject: Renewal requirements for SOC 2 re-attestation and retention

Hi Mateo,

As we prepare to renew our contract with Redwood next quarter, Procurement and our InfoSec team have one consolidated ask around SOC 2 re-attestation and audit log residency. High level: we need confirmation of where audit logs and attestation evidence will be hosted for the next 24 months, and a clear handoff plan for evidence during your recertification window.

Key asks:
- Inventory of evidence artifacts you will provide for re-attestation (CSV preferred).
- Mapping of log types (access, admin, API) to residency/region and retention period.
- A proposed schedule for evidence handoff and a contact list for the audit window.
- Estimate for committed throughput increase (we expect a 2.5x usage spike during quarter-end processing) and pricing for a 6-month dedicated burst allocation.

We attached our consolidated requirements doc for context. Can you confirm Redwood can provide the mapping and a draft amendment for the renewal (retention + burst capacity) by COB Friday? If useful, cc'ing Tom Higgins from AuditWorks — he may request sample artifacts during the review.

Thanks,
Elena Soto
Sr. Manager, Vendor Risk & Controls
LumenBank

Hi all — technical note from Security. Below is the initial mapping and constraints; I'll attach the CSV and workbook in the packet we send Friday.

Summary (draft):
- Default residency: primary audit logs (auth, admin, API) are stored in us-west-2. Secondary copies for high-availability replicate to us-east-1 (retention mirror).
- Default retention: 365 days. LumenBank request options:
  • 12 months (default) — no charge change
  • 24 months — modest storage uplift (we'll quantify in amendment)
  • 36 months — requires archive tier + retrieval SLA adjustments
- Export mechanism: SFTP export (nightly snapshots) or secure Drive share; artifacts will be packaged as .tar.gz with manifest.
- Evidence index: will include control mappings (SOC 2 criterion → artifact), sample hash values, and the timestamped export path.
- KMS/HSM: Keys are customer-scoped; we can integrate LumenBank KMS if they require customer-managed keys for stored artifacts (this will affect export lead time).

Throughput/burst notes for Capacity team:
- For a 2.5x spike sustained for up to 72 hours, we recommend a 6-month reserved burst pool with auto-scaling thresholds and a burst-credit amortization model. Ben — please draft cost options (flat monthly vs. usage amortized) and include a delta line for the renewal.

I'll upload soc2_evidence_index.csv and log-mapping-v1.xlsx by EOD today (Friday).

—Kimberly Park
Head of Security Operations | Redwood Inference
